statement: On linux with v24.9.0, test/budget.test.mjs ran twice directly (11 of 11 passing, exit 0, 5479 ms; 11 of 11 passing, exit 0, 6030 ms) and twice through tools/budget.mjs as the gate runs it (11 of 11 passing, exit 0, 5174 ms; 11 of 11 passing, exit 0, 6189 ms), against the file's 15000 ms gate row, with run to run noise of 551 ms direct and 1015 ms wrapped, so the bar is met. With the walk off (the same files, no act/shell.mjs beside them) the same wrapped command passed 10 of 11 (failed: the Linux reaper walks /proc: a detached great-grandchild tw), and the files at git HEAD f50959c passed 9 of 10, where the gate on this host read 9 of 10.
